ML Analysis System Audit    Status: SUCCESS / FAILED / PARTIAL   - Import errors, scikit-learn available, analyzer initialized   - Receiving population data, processing clusters, detecting anomalies    Initialization:   - _ml_metrics initialized in init with default values   - Fields: enabled=True, clustering={'n_clusters': 0}, anomalies={'anomaly_ratio': 0.0},   status='initialized'    Subsystems:   - HDBSCAN Clustering: enabled/min_cluster_size/min_samples/cluster_count/cluster_sizes   - Isolation Forest: enabled/contamination/n_estimators/anomaly_count/anomaly_ratio   - Dimensionality Reduction: enabled/algorithm (PCA/t-SNE)/n_components/tsne_perplexity    Events:   - phenotype_emergence: count/frequency/cluster details (hexagon nodes)   - cluster_collapse: count/frequency/merge details (pentagon nodes)   - anomaly_spike: count/frequency/anomaly details (triangle nodes)   - Event emission: wired, appearing in graph with correct shapes    Panel Display (Top-Right):   - Shows: Clusters count, Anomaly ratio (percentage)   - Status: ACTIVE / OFF   - Combined with Neural panel    Visualization:   - Component color: Lime Green (#32CD32) configurable via componentColor_ml_analysis   - Link color: Orange (#FFA500) configurable via linkColor_ml   - Filter: ml_analysis checkbox works   - Node shapes: hexagon/pentagon/triangle rendering correctly   - Animations: mlPulse, mlLinkFlow, phenotypeEmergence, clusterCollapse, anomalyDetection    Config Paths:   - /scikit/enabled, /scikit/clustering/enabled, /scikit/anomaly_detection/enabled   - /scikit/dimensionality_reduction/enabled, /scikit/clustering/min_cluster_size (default: 2)        - /scikit/anomaly_detection/contamination (default: 0.1), n_estimators (default: 300)   - /scikit/dimensionality_reduction/algorithm (tsne), n_components (3), tsne_perplexity (30)          ---   4. Meta-Cognitive Self-Tuning System Audit ⭐ NEW    Status: SUCCESS / FAILED / PARTIAL   - Config tuner initialized, mode (autonomous/learning/observing/off)   - Tuning interval: default 50 frames   - Safe parameters list: 25+ parameters tunable    Modes:   - autonomous: Full self-tuning without human approval   - learning: Proposes changes, learns from outcomes   - observing: Monitors but doesn't act   - off: Disabled    Metrics:   - total_actions: Total tuning attempts   - successful_actions: Successful parameter changes   - success_rate: Ratio of successful to total actions   - param_success_rates: Per-parameter success tracking   - recent_actions: Last N actions with details (param, change, reason, success)    Performance Targets:   - min_cluster_diversity: 3   - max_anomaly_ratio: 0.2   - min_fitness_std: 0.05    Safe Parameters (can be tuned):   - evolution.mutation_rate.initial, evolution.population_size,   evolution.adaptation_sensitivity   - feedback.knobs.* (mutation_rate, new_edge_rate, clustering_bias, quantum_pruning)   - neural.training.learning_rate, neural.training.gamma, neural.training.epsilon_decay,   neural.training.batch_size   - neural.rewards.* (fitness_improvement, connection_success, survival)   - network.max_organisms, network.max_connections, network.resource_pool   - scikit.clustering.min_cluster_size, scikit.anomaly_detection.contamination,   scikit.anomaly_detection.n_estimators   - quantum.initial_states, quantum.entanglement_sensitivity, quantum.prune_check_interval   - vp_monitoring.adaptive_response.high_vp_threshold,   vp_monitoring.stabilization.smoothing_factor   - causation_detection.correlation_threshold   - meta_cognitive.self_tuning.tuning_interval_frames,   meta_cognitive.self_tuning.min_confidence_threshold    Panel Display (Bottom-Right):   - Shows: Mode (AUTONOMOUS/LEARNING/OBSERVING), Actions count, Success rate (percentage), Last        action   - Status: OFF if disabled   - Note: Actions=0 is normal before first tuning interval (frame 50)    Config Paths:   - /meta_cognitive/self_tuning/enabled   - /meta_cognitive/self_tuning/mode   - /meta_cognitive/self_tuning/tuning_interval_frames (default: 50)   - /meta_cognitive/self_tuning/min_confidence_threshold (default: 0.6)   - /meta_cognitive/self_tuning/safe_parameters (array)   - /meta_cognitive/self_tuning/performance_targets    Integration:   - CRA can control via CONFIG_UPDATE capability   - Can toggle enabled status, switch modes, adjust interval, change confidence threshold   - Action history available via get_stats()    ---   5. VP Monitoring System Audit ⭐ ENHANCED    Status: SUCCESS / FAILED / PARTIAL   - ViolationMonitor enabled, diagnostics logging   - Component decomposition enabled   - Adaptive thresholds enabled   - Stabilization enabled    Component Decomposition:   - trait_divergence: Weight 0.25 - measures how far traits are from ideal centers   - quantum_entropy: Weight 0.20 - quantum state disorder   - evolution_pressure: Weight 0.20 - evolutionary stress   - network_coherence: Weight 0.20 - network connectivity health   - phase_mismatch: Weight 0.15 - phase transition alignment    Adaptive Thresholds:   - Dynamic envelope widening based on sustained violations   - Per-trait radius adjustment (organism_count, modularity, clustering_coefficient,   average_path_length)   - Fallback reset when envelopes exceed limits    Stabilization:   - smoothing_factor: 0.25 - smooths VP jumps   - max_jump: 0.1 - maximum allowed VP change per frame   - history_size: 15 - rolling window for smoothing   - Prevents VP oscillation    VP Classification:   - VP0: < 0.25 (healthy)   - VP1: 0.25-0.50 (mild pressure)   - VP2: 0.50-0.75 (moderate pressure)   - VP3: 0.75-0.99 (high pressure)   - VP4: ≥ 0.99 (critical collapse risk)    Panel Display (Bottom-Left):   - Shows: VP value (4 decimals), Classification (VP0-VP4)   - Combined with Evolution metrics (Generation, Population, Best/Avg Fitness)    Diagnostics Logging:   - Log file: data/logs/vp_diagnostics.log   - Per-trait contributions, envelope adjustments, stabilization actions    Config Paths:   - /vp_monitoring/diagnostics_enabled   - /vp_monitoring/component_decomposition_enabled   - /vp_monitoring/component_weights   - /vp_monitoring/adaptive_thresholds_enabled (also   /vp_monitoring/adaptive_thresholds/enabled)   - /vp_monitoring/adaptive_response/high_vp_threshold (default: 0.75)   - /vp_monitoring/adaptive_response/streak_threshold (default: 3)   - /vp_monitoring/stabilization_enabled (also /vp_monitoring/stabilization/enabled)   - /vp_monitoring/stabilization/smoothing_factor, max_jump, history_size    ---   6. Causation Detection Audit    Config: All causation_detection settings in config.json verified   - Toggles: enable_neural_causations (master), enable_neural_decision_causations,   enable_neural_training_causations, enable_phase_transition_causations,   enable_bidirectional_causations, enable_ml_causations (NEW)    Link Generation:   - Neural decision/training links created when toggles enabled   - ML analysis links created (phenotype/cluster/anomaly events)   - Phase transition/bidirectional links work   - Time windows respected (direct_causation_time_window: 2, phase_transition_time_window: 2.0)        Graph: Neural nodes/links appear, ML nodes/links appear, filters work, CRA can control    Config Paths:   - /causation_detection/enable_neural_causations   - /causation_detection/enable_neural_decision_causations   - /causation_detection/enable_neural_training_causations   - /causation_detection/enable_phase_transition_causations   - /causation_detection/enable_bidirectional_causations   - /causation_detection/correlation_threshold (default: 0.6)   - /causation_detection/direct_causation_time_window (default: 2)   - /causation_detection/phase_transition_time_window (default: 2.0)   - /causation_detection/recent_events_window (default: 300)    ---   8.
